chunks.title: Cedar-Plank Salmon
chunks.text: Cedar-Plank Salmon — $32. Wild Pacific salmon with a maple-miso glaze, roasted fingerling potatoes, and charred broccolini. Contains fish and soy. The glaze contains gluten, so the standard preparation is not gluten-free.

chunks.title: Wild Mushroom Burger
chunks.text: Wild Mushroom Burger — $21. A grilled mushroom and lentil patty with alpine cheese, caramelized onions, arugula, and roasted garlic aioli on a brioche bun. Vegetarian. Contains dairy, egg, and gluten; it is not vegan in its standard preparation.

chunks.title: Roasted Root Vegetable Bowl
chunks.text: Roasted Root Vegetable Bowl — $19. Quinoa, roasted carrots and beets, massaged kale, pickled cabbage, pumpkin seeds, and maple-tahini dressing. Vegan and gluten-free. Contains sesame; guests with severe allergies should speak with the restaurant.

chunks.title: Dungeness Crab Cakes
chunks.text: Dungeness Crab Cakes — $18. Two pan-seared crab cakes with shaved fennel slaw and lemon aioli. Contains shellfish, egg, and gluten. Served as a starter.

chunks.title: Seasonal Berry Pavlova
chunks.text: Seasonal Berry Pavlova — $12. Crisp meringue with berry compote, whipped mascarpone, and lemon verbena. Vegetarian and gluten-free. Contains egg and dairy.

chunks.title: Spruce Tip & Blackberry Soda
chunks.text: Spruce Tip & Blackberry Soda — $7. A non-alcoholic house soda with spruce tip syrup, blackberry, lemon, and sparkling water. Vegan and gluten-free. Available during dinner service while the seasonal syrup lasts.

chunks.title: Smoked Salmon Chowder
chunks.text: Smoked Salmon Chowder — $14. Creamy chowder with house-smoked salmon, corn, leek, potato, and dill oil. Contains fish and dairy. A cup is served with grilled sourdough containing gluten.

chunks.title: Pacific Oysters
chunks.text: Pacific Oysters — $24 for six. Chilled local oysters with apple mignonette, horseradish, and lemon. Gluten-free. Contains shellfish; consuming raw shellfish carries health risks.

chunks.title: Charred Cabbage
chunks.text: Charred Cabbage — $13. Savoy cabbage with sunflower-seed cream, chili crisp, and herbs. Vegan. The chili crisp contains gluten; a gluten-free preparation is not currently offered.

chunks.title: Sourdough Board
chunks.text: Sourdough Board — $10. Warm local sourdough with cultured sea-salt butter and roasted garlic. Vegetarian. Contains dairy and gluten.

chunks.title: Herb-Roasted Chicken
chunks.text: Herb-Roasted Chicken — $28. Half chicken with celery-root purée, roasted mushrooms, chicken jus, and fresh herbs. Gluten-free. Contains dairy and celery.

chunks.title: Braised Beef Short Rib
chunks.text: Braised Beef Short Rib — $34. Red-wine-braised beef with parsnip purée, glazed carrots, and crispy shallots. Contains dairy, sulphites, and gluten.

chunks.title: Seared Pacific Halibut
chunks.text: Seared Pacific Halibut — $36. Halibut with spring pea risotto, asparagus, preserved lemon, and brown butter. Gluten-free. Contains fish and dairy.

chunks.title: Market Greens
chunks.text: Market Greens — $12. Mixed local greens, shaved radish, cucumber, herbs, toasted sunflower seeds, and cider vinaigrette. Vegan and gluten-free.

chunks.title: Sea-Salt Fries
chunks.text: Sea-Salt Fries — $9. Skin-on fries with rosemary sea salt and roasted garlic aioli. Vegetarian and gluten-free by ingredients, but cooked in a shared fryer. Aioli contains egg.

chunks.title: Roasted Broccolini
chunks.text: Roasted Broccolini — $11. Broccolini with lemon, garlic, chili, and toasted hazelnuts. Vegan and gluten-free. Contains tree nuts.

chunks.title: Dark Chocolate Torte
chunks.text: Dark Chocolate Torte — $13. Flourless dark chocolate torte with espresso crème fraîche and cocoa nib brittle. Vegetarian and gluten-free. Contains dairy and egg.

chunks.title: Green Apple Sorbet
chunks.text: Green Apple Sorbet — $9. Dairy-free green apple sorbet with mint and candied ginger. Vegan and gluten-free.

chunks.title: Coffee and Tea
chunks.text: Drip coffee is $4, espresso is $4, and a pot of loose-leaf tea is $6. Oat milk is available at no extra charge. Ask the server for the current tea selection.

chunks.title: Wine and Beer
chunks.text: Cedar & Salt offers a rotating selection of British Columbia wine and craft beer. Glasses of wine start at $12 and draft beer starts at $8. Specific producers and availability change; ask the restaurant for the current list.

chunks.title: Dinner Hours
chunks.text: Dinner hours are Tuesday through Thursday from 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM, Friday and Saturday from 5:00 PM to 11:00 PM, and Sunday from 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM. Cedar & Salt is closed on Mondays.

chunks.title: Kitchen Closing Times
chunks.text: The kitchen accepts its final food orders 30 minutes before the published closing time. The bar may continue service until closing. Holiday hours can differ and should be confirmed directly.

chunks.title: Location and Transit
chunks.text: Cedar & Salt is a fictional portfolio restaurant located at 1280 Seawall Avenue, Vancouver, BC. It is a five-minute walk from Harbour Station and is served by the number 19 bus.

chunks.title: Parking
chunks.text: Metered street parking is available nearby. A paid underground parkade is located one block east at Harbour Station. Cedar & Salt does not validate parking.

chunks.title: Reservations
chunks.text: Reservations are accepted online for parties of one to six up to 30 days in advance. A limited number of bar seats are held for walk-in guests. Same-day availability changes and cannot be guaranteed by the assistant.

chunks.title: Large Parties
chunks.text: Parties of seven to twelve must contact the restaurant directly. A family-style set menu may be required. Cedar & Salt does not accept groups larger than twelve in the main dining room.

chunks.title: Pickup and Delivery
chunks.text: Online pickup is available Tuesday through Sunday from 5:00 PM to 8:30 PM. Cedar & Salt does not currently offer delivery. Not every dine-in item is available for pickup.

chunks.title: Accessibility
chunks.text: The entrance, dining room, and washroom are wheelchair accessible. Guests who need a lower table or extra maneuvering space can add a note to their reservation.

chunks.title: Allergy Policy
chunks.text: Cedar & Salt identifies common allergens in menu descriptions, but the kitchen handles gluten, dairy, egg, soy, sesame, tree nuts, fish, and shellfish. Cross-contact is possible. Guests with severe allergies must notify the restaurant before ordering; the assistant cannot guarantee allergen-free preparation.

chunks.title: Payments and Gratuity
chunks.text: Cedar & Salt accepts major credit cards, debit cards, and cash. Bills can be split across up to four payments. An 18% gratuity is added to parties of seven or more.

chunks.title: Gift Cards
chunks.text: Digital gift cards are available in amounts from $25 to $250 and do not expire. Gift cards can be used for dine-in meals but cannot be redeemed for cash.
